title: Pondering Pearl Pufferfish
statement: A small, thoughtful pufferfish who collects single grains of glowing sand and arranges them into constellations on the floor of a moonlit tank of deep teal water. When a pattern pleases her, she puffs up into a pearly sphere and drifts in a slow, satisfied spin, while the swaying kelp and one lopsided ceramic teapot look on.
